Slot Insulation Paper Manufacturer in India

Class E Fish Paper for Slot, Phase & Turn-to-Turn Insulation

Harnawa Insulations is a recognized manufacturer of Slot Insulation Paper in India offering good quality laminated insulation paper which is also referred to as Fish Paper. Our Slot Insulation Paper belongs to our  (https://harnawainc.com/laminated-insulation-paper-composites/) Laminated Insulation Paper Composites category and consists of the electrical characteristics of the press paper along with the mechanical characteristics of the polyester film.

Product Overview

Slot Insulation Paper is made up of two-layer laminated sheets, which include a combination of 100% sulfate wood pulp presspaper and PET polyester film using B-class Adhesive. The paper provides fiber strength and flexibility, whereas the polyester film helps increase the dielectric strength, smoothness of the surface, and water resistance properties of the material, making it flexible even at lower temperatures.

They all indicate the same specification of Fish Paper that is of Class E and has a temperature rating of 120°c. Irrespective of what name you use for ordering, Harnawa guarantees you the same product with similar specifications.

Domestic Supply — As an Indian manufacturer, our supply will be much quicker than that of our international competitors

Applications

Slot insulation – Slot liner for electric motors and generators to act as an insulator between the stator windings and core

Phase insulation – To insulate individual winding phases to avoid electrical breakdown

Turn-to-turn insulation – Insulator between the winding turns within the coil

Liner insulation – General lining used in motor and appliance construction

Frequently Asked Questions

1.What else is slot insulation paper known by?

It is widely referred to as Fish Paper; it is also available in India with trade names such as FDR, Garlam, Griflex, and Triplex, which are all synonymous for the same Class E, 120°C laminated material.

2.For what thermal class is slot insulation paper qualified?

Slot Insulation Paper is qualified Class E (120°C); ideal for use in Class E and Class B motors and electric appliances.

3.Are there any options for customization of slot insulation paper?

Yes – in multiple thicknesses (0.10mm-0.60mm); custom colors, and supply forms (rolls, sheets, strips).

4.Which other types of insulation materials are used along with slot insulation paper?

Slot Insulation Paper is generally used with  (https://harnawainc.com/insulation-tapes/) insulation tapes and slot wedges.

5.How does buying from an Indian manufacturer beat out importation of slot insulation paper?

Buying slot insulation paper from Harnawa, as a slot insulation paper manufacturer in India, saves time, avoids customs duty and transport delays, and gives you immediate technical assistance for your requirement.
